scope: Separate informed follow-up after the closed initial condition. Not a new blind trial and excluded from original trial timing/comparison.

approach.armholes: Extracted the two actual 42-edge body armhole boundary loops; made rounded cap bridges sharing those exact vertex indices; joined lower sleeve surfaces into the same cloth mesh. This is real topology rather than a trim strip covering a gap.
approach.sleeve_preservation: Retained 440 original lower cage vertices per side from the s=.14 m ring onward. Existing cuff objects and lower sleeve length endpoints stay unchanged.
approach.body_preservation: Retained all 970 original body cage vertices and existing body faces; connected new cap faces to the open armhole edges. The body subdivision level increased from one to two as the surfaces became one connected editable shell.
approach.editability: Left and right sleeves are named vertex groups within the continuous body mesh; cuffs, piping, buckle hardware, lapels, collar and decoration remain separate objects. Subdivision and solidify remain live.
approach.shoulder_tabs: Raycast onto the evaluated shoulder surface to fit tab vertices, pale edge and button, retaining the existing pieces and materials.

protected_checks.approach: One mesh, shared armhole boundary vertices/edges, rounded cap bridge; existing lower sleeve cages retained; shoulder trim fitted by surface raycasts
changed_objects: Body | continuous open front and shoulder yoke

before_after_observations.before: Open black gaps between sleeve cap and torso near the shoulder; pale epaulette edges visibly floated above the yoke.
before_after_observations.after: The top/side armhole gaps close and the shoulder silhouette is continuous. Tabs lie on the shoulder surface.

before_after_observations.before: The gap exposes disconnected body and sleeve shells; inner sleeve caps appear detached through the open front.
before_after_observations.after: The shell reads as connected cloth around the shoulder. The intentional open front/neck and cuff openings remain visible.

before_after_observations.before: The root/cap junction and tab height are discontinuous.
before_after_observations.after: The upper sleeve joins the yoke and the tab follows its surface. Some cap irregularity and underarm pinching remain.

residual_problems: Underarm transitions are pinched, most clearly from back and rear-three-quarter views; topology is continuous but tailoring curvature needs further refinement.
The main cloth remains brighter and more blue-grey under these lights than the original black reference; materials were intentionally unchanged.
Collar/lapel stiffness, front buckle placement, approximate shield/fleur and chain routing, and occluded rear ornament remain from the original asset.
Cloth UV unwrap, rigging, deformation, simulation and target-engine validation remain unperformed.
Diagnostic renders use 24 samples and show grain.
The shared body/sleeve mesh changes object-level sleeve selection into named vertex-group selection. Cuffs remain separately editable under the same object names.
